title: Zugzwang — original AI chess engine with rigorous finite self-play benchmark
desc: Build and publish an original high-quality locally runnable chess engine/bot in dedicated dreamer2664/zugzwang, playable through standard UCI and an easy CLI. Build authentic legal move/search/evaluation/training modules, tests and full source. Primary challenge: preregister and preserve an independently chosen balanced tournament suite, demonstrate 100% draws when the identical immutable engine binary/config plays itself and 100% wins for the full build against a genuinely but slightly weaker same-family model/search-budget copy on the separately predeclared test suite, if these results are achieved. Never special-case opponent IDs, rig moves, discard losses, tune on hidden holdout, tamper clocks or alter the suite after observing results. Chess is unsolved: this finite reproducible result is not a theorem for every legal position/game; if the strict result is not met, report exact verified outcomes and continue improving instead of claiming universal success. Full charter zugzwang/ZUGZWANG.md. Own exhaustive HANDOFF, honest benchmarks and source/tests, <=5min genuine updates, no arbitrary night/hour quota.
